explication: XERJ is a local AI search and indexing engine. Its main user workflow is to point autoindex at a corpus, have it identify and index content, then retrieve ranked passages or code references through search and agent-facing interfaces. The graph also preserves documented hybrid/vector search, agent memory, MCP, and the console. Source excerpts are sparse, so links not explicitly documented or visible in the source index are marked unverified rather than asserted.
